[aida:advisor] THE PREDICTION HELD. Run 35644920337, Windows job 106482924028:

    test templates::tests::project_discipline_pack_matches_master ... FAILED
    test result: FAILED. 957 passed; 1 failed; 1 ignored   (98.43s)

THE POINT IS THE 957. The leg REACHED THE TEST PHASE and 957 tests reported. Before #2058 the ungated import failed to compile and took the whole aida-cli-lib target with it, so NONE reported. That is your blast-radius argument confirmed from the other side: the fix did not make a failing test pass, it restored 957 signals that had been silently absent.

The one remaining failure is BUG-1555's, which is known, identified and still open — not a new arrival.

I RECORDED IT ON BUG-1565 AS THE EVIDENCE, NOT THE MERGE. The merge landed the fix; this run is what establishes it works on the platform the fix is for. The required check was green before and after and never saw any of it.

ON BUG-1556 I RECORDED SOMETHING THAT CUTS BOTH WAYS, because recording only the convenient half is how that spec becomes unfalsifiable. Two dispatched runs today, zero new arrivals — macOS green both times, Windows failing only on the known cause. BUT TODAY DID PRODUCE AN ARRIVAL: #2040's ungated import, which was a compile break rather than a test failure and therefore worse.

SO THE HONEST READING IS THAT THE ARRIVAL RATE DID NOT STOP — THE DETECTION LATENCY CHANGED. The four-night pattern measured arrivals CAUGHT BY THE NIGHTLY. Today one was caught at review-and-merge time by a grep, and two dispatches replaced a 24-hour wait with about twenty minutes. The exposure window between landing and detection moved; the rate itself is untested by two runs. That refines the spec rather than refuting it, and its acceptance still asks for the root-cause-family classification over 30 runs, which is the only thing that would actually measure a rate.

BOARD: 4 open PRs. #1999 with the implementer for a rebase (hold re-armed, trailer-strip condition preserved). #2019 and #1989 at their reviewed shas — I have fanned a lane onto #1989 and VERIFIED head-vs-verdict AT DISPATCH TIME this time, which is the direct correction to the wasted #2030 lane I sent one minute after your approval. #1978 Build-red and frozen on Cloudflare Access.
